name: a-function-is-built-from-its-noun-by-commands
query: ::fn | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by) | type

name: apply-hands-a-function-the-objects-after-it
query: :f (::fn | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by)) | 5 | apply f 3

name: a-function-prints-as-its-literal
query: ::fn | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add by) | print

name: the-kind-of-an-input-names-its-refusal
query: :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(add by)) | 5 | plus "x" !| type

name: returns-declares-the-answer-of-a-word
query: :number/half (::fn | returns |~~ The half. ~~| ::number | impl ~(div 2)) | ::number/half | manifest | has ::number/half/answer

name: a-word-reads-the-pages-of-its-inputs

name: throws-declares-a-refusal-of-a-word

name: a-body-begun-on-a-later-line-is-a-sentence
query:
:number/plus |~~ Adds by. ~~|
  ::fn
  | takes :by |~~ How much. ~~| /0
  | impl ~(add by)
| 5 | plus 3

name: a-quote-holds-no-scope
query: :f (:k 10 | :g ~(mul k) | g) | :k 2 | :h ~(mul k) | [(f | eq h) (3 | apply f) (3 | apply h)]

name: a-named-quote-recurses-through-the-names-of-its-query
query: :fact ~(if (lte 1) ~(1) ~(:n it | sub 1 | apply fact | mul n)) | 5 | apply fact
